easyPrerequisites: You have not cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Displacer Kitten and Kykar trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Muldrotha.
Resolve the Kykar trigger, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.
